tones.label: MAD Ventures confident
tones.direction: Confident and ambitious, MAD Ventures style: short declarative sentences, forward momentum, no hype words like 'game-changing'.

tones.label: Casual
tones.direction: Relaxed and conversational, like texting a friend. Contractions are fine; at most one emoji.

tones.label: Educational
tones.direction: Teaches one clear thing. Plain language, one idea per sentence, no jargon.

tones.label: Playful
tones.direction: Playful, with wordplay or light humor, while still clear about the point.
